# Technical Writing Tips for Engineers

Writing is a core engineering skill. Here's what I've learned:

## Lead with the outcome

State what the reader will achieve before explaining how.

## Use active voice

*The server returns a 200* beats *A 200 is returned by the server*.

## One idea per paragraph

If you need a conjunction to join two sentences, consider splitting them into separate paragraphs.

## Read it aloud

You'll catch awkward phrasing instantly.

Practice every day. Your future self will thank you.
